name: ceramics-api

dependencies.name: ceramics-db
dependencies.description: Stores products, categories, carts, orders, and order items.

dependencies.name: user-auth
dependencies.description: Validates shopper and store-owner sign-in tokens issued via Thunder SSO.

dependencies.name: payment-provider

config.description: Secret API key for the Stripe account

dependencies.description: Charges the shopper's payment method during checkout via the Stripe SDK.

dependencies.name: email-provider

config.description: Secret API key for the SendGrid account

dependencies.description: Sends order-confirmation emails after checkout via the SendGrid SDK.

description: The backend for the ceramics store: exposes the product/category catalog, cart, checkout, and order endpoints used by both the storefront and admin web apps, and enforces store-owner-only access on catalog and order-management operations. Does not render any UI and does not issue its own auth tokens — Thunder is the identity provider.
